verdict.rationale: Together's dedicated OpenAI-compatibility docs page states that an existing OpenAI client can be pointed at Together-hosted models with exactly two changes, the API key and the base URL. This matches the story directly. The API reference also exposes an OpenAI-shaped POST /v1/chat/completions endpoint. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that drop-in use works, and detail on which endpoints and parameters are covered by the compatibility layer.
